text:
elaine: Quick sync — we need a zonal latency heatmap + a clear metric for cross-region failovers for the new Console 'Region View'. Who's taking runtime instrumentation for this?

sam: I can start. Is the ask just p50/p95/p99 per region/zone, or do we want per-route as well?

elaine: Ideally per-route (v1/generate, v1/embeddings) and per-model class (small/large) — but we need to balance cardinality. Heatmap should be region x zone with cell = p95 latency.

jon: +1 on per-route. Also we need a "failover impact" metric: how many requests had to failover, and their post-failover latency + error delta. Something like failover.count and failover.latency_delta_ms.

isha: Important to capture original_region and final_region labels so we can compute cross-region hops. But high-cardinality could blow up prometheus. Proposal: emit original_region label only on sparse samples tagged as failover=true, and keep aggregated counters for counts.

kevin: Agreed. For the heatmap we can use histogram buckets exported as summary pXX; but for dashboards we usually prefer precomputed p95. Runtime can emit p95 approximate via HDR histograms periodically.

maria: Telemetry retention / rollups: Console team wants 90d rollups at daily granularity and 7d at 5m granularity. Can infra handle that?

jon: That's product-side retention ask. Grafana/TSDB can roll up, but initial ingest cost depends on label cardinality. If we attach route+model+zone labels on every sample it's noisy.

sam: Compromise plan: emit full labels for 1% sampled traces and for all failover events; emit lean metrics for all requests with labels: region, zone_shard (coarse), route_group (generate/embeddings), model_class (small/large).

elaine: Sounds reasonable. What's route_group mapping? We should document in Console API spec so UX can map routes to product features.

sam: route_group = {"/v1/generate*":"generate", "/v1/embeddings*":"embeddings", default:"other"}. We'll add mapping in infra-telemetry repo.

jon: For failover metric names I'd suggest: redwood.failover.count{orig_region,final_region,reason}, redwood.failover.latency_delta_ms{orig_region,final_region}. Keep these emitted only when failover occurs.

isha: Also add label routing_policy=preferred|fallback so we can separate policy-triggered vs capacity-triggered failovers.

kevin: Note on quotas: if a user hits quota and we redirect traffic to a lower-cost model, that looks like a 'policy fallback' not a region failover. We need an explicit label policy_action=quota_throttle|model_fallback|region_failover.

maria: Console wants a single aggregated metric for "user-facing severity": failover_rate_by_region and heatmap p95. We'll derive dashboards from the emitted labels.

sam: Implementation plan: runtime PR to emit new metrics and labels (sam), infra-telemetry update for mapping & scrape config (jon), TSDB retention + rollup config (kevin), Console dashboard JSON (maria). I'll open PRs today.

elaine: Thanks. Can we also add a tiny example for the metrics team?

sam: Example metrics we will emit:
```
# aggregated per-request lean metric (all requests)
redwood.request.latency_ms_bucket{region="us-west-2",zone_shard="a",route_group="generate",model_class="small",le="100"} <count>

# failover event (emitted only on failover)
redwood.failover.count{orig_region="us-east-1",final_region="us-west-2",reason="capacity",routing_policy="fallback",policy_action="region_failover"} 1
redwood.failover.latency_delta_ms{orig_region="us-east-1",final_region="us-west-2"} 120
```

jon: That looks good. Couple of notes: use zone_shard not exact zone to avoid label explosion (shard = coarse grouping of 3 zones). Keep model_class coarse.

isha: Also let's ensure we propagate request_id and sample_id to traces for debug, but not as labels. Use trace logs for per-request debugging.

kevin: Ops ask: include a small QPS tag on the failover events so we can correlate with load spikes. Maybe failover.qps_bucket label? Or emit a separate redwood.zone.qps metric per minute.

sam: We'll emit redwood.zone.qps{region,zone_shard} with 1m scrape.

maria: UX request: in the Console we want hover details showing p50/p95/p99, failover_rate, and top 3 routes causing failovers. That maps to the labels we discussed.

elaine: OK action items: sam open runtime PR + perf estimate, jon update infra-telemetry scrape + rollup, kevin confirm storage cost estimate, maria prototype dashboard card, isha add trace debug spec. We'll reconvene after PRs land. :thumbsup:

telemetry-bot: New ticket created: TICKET-4287 - "Zonal Heatmap + Failover Metrics" assigned to sam, jon, kevin, maria, isha

sam: I'll ping when PR is ready for review.

maria: I'll start the dashboard skeleton this afternoon.

jon: FYI I'll add a lint rule to infra-telemetry to flag high-cardinality labels.

elaine: Great, thanks everyone.
